_comment: Scenarios executed by run-all-benchmarks.sh. Each entry: script (a bench-*.sh),
category, label, and a params object whose keys are that script's flag names in
The first six mirror nats/scripts/scenarios.json one-for-one (baseline / large-message
/ multi-client throughput, RTT check, steady one-way latency, scalability sweep) so the
two projects' run-index.csv files can be compared row by row. The trailing entries
cover what has no NATS equivalent at all: RELIABLE QoS, shared-memory transport, and
many-topic fan-out. Those are where Fast DDS does something NATS Core cannot, so
leaving them out would make the comparison flattering to NATS by omission.

scenarios.label: reliable-baseline
scenarios._comment: history keep_all is required, not optional: RELIABLE + KEEP_LAST is NOT lossless. RELIABLE guarantees delivery of what the writer still holds, and KEEP_LAST caps that at history-depth samples - measured, an unthrottled 100000-message run lost 679 at depth 100.
